requested_changes.requirement: Represent production as two distinct regions: primary and secondary.

evidence.observation: The instruction states that production now runs in two regions.
The existing production section was relabeled “3A · Primary-region canary & automatic rollback,” and a separate “3B · Secondary-region canary & scoped rollback” section was added.

evidence.locator: production areas in the lower half
evidence.observation: The post-edit board visibly separates the primary and secondary regional canary systems.

requested_changes.note: Both production regions are structurally and visually distinct.

requested_changes.requirement: Make the secondary-region canary begin only after the primary-region canary completes.

evidence.observation: The primary canary must complete before the secondary canary begins.
The primary completion note now says to begin the secondary canary, and s0 runs from that completion note to the secondary controller with label “primary complete · same revision.”
A directed green connection visibly links primary completion to the secondary canary controller.

requested_changes.note: The dependency is communicated as a directed system flow, not merely as a label.

requested_changes.requirement: Use the same revision for the secondary-region canary.

evidence.observation: The secondary canary must use the same revision.
The completion note specifies “the same immutable revision,” and the transition is labeled “primary complete · same revision.”

requested_changes.note: The revision identity is explicitly carried across the regional transition.

requested_changes.requirement: On a secondary-region failure, roll back only the secondary region unless the shared business metric breaches.

evidence.observation: A secondary failure is region-scoped unless the shared business metric breaches.

evidence.locator: objects.added[secondary-health, secondary-freeze, business-breach, secondary-rollback] and connections.added[s5,s6,s7]
evidence.observation: The secondary failure path freezes that rollout, tests the shared business metric, and sends the “no” branch to “Rollback secondary region only.”
The post-edit diagram visibly routes a secondary failure through the shared-metric decision to a secondary-only rollback.

requested_changes.note: The isolated rollback is represented by an explicit decision branch and rollback process.

requested_changes.requirement: If the shared business metric breaches, roll back both regions to the last known-good image.

evidence.observation: A shared business-metric breach must return both regions to the last known-good image.
The “yes” branch from “Shared business metric breached?” leads to “Rollback both regions to last known-good image.”
The policy note reiterates that only a shared business-metric breach triggers rollback in both regions.

requested_changes.note: Both the behavior and target image are explicitly communicated.

verdict.scope_summary: All atomic requests landed: the prior production flow was identified as primary, a separate secondary canary was added, the same revision is handed off only after primary completion, and secondary failure branches correctly between regional-only and both-region rollback. The largest in-scope effect is the new 3B secondary-region flow and its nine connections. There is no out-of-scope redesign; the only extra diff is the page-frame height increase, which is the minimum necessary accommodation to contain the added region. The commit summary declares the regional canaries and rollback policies represented by the diff.
